answer_1.quote: Prompt refinement systems are optimized to automatically translate user language into system language.

answer_2.quote: Automated assessments utilize ImageReward and HPSv2, which are trained to mimic human preferences and have been demonstrated to accurately align with actual human judgments.

answer_4.quote: Humans annotate relevance and win ratios. ... We recruit annotators to manually evaluate the output images.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate relevance on a scale of 0 to 2 for prompt-image alignment and perform pairwise comparisons to choose the better image based on text-image alignment and image quality.
